features: Special-category leaderboard filters from dev63 are removed; the progression leaderboard remains Novice, Intermediate and Advanced
Special-category points continue to flow only into the competitor's applicable BDC progression division
Shared HallOfFameService now powers Hall of Fame data
Hall of Fame cards are grouped by event and category and display the official category label
Public read-only Hall of Fame JSON API is available at /api/hall-of-fame/
WordPress-ready Hall of Fame embed is available at /hall-of-fame/embed/
Homepage embed defaults to Bachata Rising, Bachata Open and Bachata Invitational results
WordPress Custom HTML integration example is included under integrations/wordpress/
